input.note: I want to understand how to have medicine delivered to my home without going out.

batch.message: One new step for what you need now.

tasks.title: Find out if a pharmacy can deliver
tasks.summary: Prescription delivery is different from routine refill shipping, and each pharmacy sets its own limits. Check a possible route without needing a prescription or choosing a medicine.
steps: Open CVS’s prescription-delivery information as one starting point; you can also check a pharmacy you already use, if applicable.
Check whether delivery serves your area and which prescriptions qualify; confirm charges, timing, and any ID or handoff requirements directly with the pharmacy.
Keep in mind that checking the service does not confirm eligibility for any future prescription or arrange a delivery.
tasks.done_when: You understand what to verify and whether this delivery route is worth considering.

resources.why: A US pharmacy’s delivery information provides a concrete starting point; its limits and costs need direct confirmation.
